name: CONTINUUM
subtitle: Work, life, and a little chaos.
localizedDescription: A native workspace with a sourced profile from your private Zay — Continuity website. Connect selected non-sensitive categories to seed preferences and project context for Calibrate. Refresh source changes on the signed-in website, then sync the profile to your phone. Source-grounded questions, Deep Dive, reviewed answers, cloud drafts and AI Spark. Authoritative approvals remain in Continuity. Unsigned for Feather; iOS 16.4 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: New native Continuity profile with source text, revisions and refresh controls. Selected categories seed initial calibration; signed-in website refreshes preserve scope exclusions and can be paused. Source refresh requires opening the private website. 48 core tests, 22 native tests, TypeScript and macOS device build passed. Physical iPhone runtime remains unverified.

Cloud-connected release with source-grounded Calibrate, adaptive Deep Dive, answer review and AI Spark. Fixes cloud-aware home counts and AI help. Live website sign-in, authorized context import, cloud answer persistence, real AI generation, favorites and idempotent pending proposals verified. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS device archive passed. Physical iPhone acceptance remains pending.

Cloud auth and sync; explicit scoped context import on the private website; source-grounded server Calibrate and adaptive Deep Dive; reviewable targeted proposals; AI Spark and favorites. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS Release device build passed. Physical iPhone acceptance is pending. Rule-based question selection; no automatic access to private website sessions.

First native iOS preview: five screens, persistent Quick Calibrate drafts, adaptive follow-ups, review/edit/skip, and Spark history/favorites. 19 native tests, 31 existing tests, TypeScript, Expo Doctor, Release device/simulator builds, and two iOS simulator flows passed. Physical iPhone installation, signing, haptics, and VoiceOver remain untested. No live Continuity or AI connection.
